CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.OFFL_EksportOpe @ID INT -- ID oddziału (PK z tabeli CDN.PicoKonfig) AS DECLARE @Typ_Ope SMALLINT SET @Typ_Ope = 128
SELECT Ope_GIDNumer, Ope_Ident, Ope_Nazwisko, Ope_Haslo, Ope_Haslo_chk, Ope_Administrator, Ope_Dyrektor, CASE WHEN Ope_Zablokowane=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Ope_Zablokowane, Ope_WidziCenyZakupu, Pck_Blokady&1 As Ope_BlokadaTwr, (Pck_Blokady&2)/2 As Ope_BlokadaCenSpr, (Pck_Blokady&4)/4 AS Ope_BlokadaCenZak, (Pck_Blokady&8)/8 AS Ope_BlokadaCenZam FROM CDN.FrmStruktura JOIN CDN.FrmLinki ON FrL_GrOTyp=FrS_GIDTyp AND FrL_GrONumer=FrS_GIDNumer AND FrL_GIDTyp=@Typ_Ope JOIN CDN.OpeKarty ON FrL_GIDNumer = Ope_GIDNUmer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON FRS_ID=Pck_CentrumID WHERE Pck_PicoID = @ID
